title: Classify a null registration GET envelope as malformed response rather than transport loss
outcome: Valid JSON with an invalid response shape receives a response-contract diagnostic while still refusing execution.
acceptance: HTTP200 JSONnull and other invalid envelope controls produce response-shape/contract classification rather than transport_failure.
The controls preserve known status and no-execution guarantees; positive exact-query admission remains unchanged.
Relevant authorized tests pass with host-recorded evidence.
